map.双支撑>12% 提示步速减慢或不稳（如帕金森/偏瘫），<8% 为步速加快，正常约: Double support above 12% indicates slowed or unstable walking (as in Parkinson disease or hemiplegia), below 8% indicates faster walking; normal is about 10%.
map.步速变化会影响比例吗？: Does walking speed affect the ratio?
map.会。正常步速下支撑相约 60%、摆动相约 40%；步速减慢时支撑相占比升高（走得: Yes. At normal speed the stance phase is about 60% and the swing phase about 40%; when speed drops the stance share rises (the slower the walk, the longer the stance), and when walking fast the swing share rises. So comparing two measurements requires fixing the speed (choose a comfortable speed and record the speed value at the same time), otherwise a difference in the ratio may only reflect a difference in speed rather than a functional change.
